# Görkem Tanağardıgil

> Senior software engineer and former submarine officer. ASCII spelling: Gorkem Tanagardigil.

Personal site: https://www.gorkemtanagardigil.com

Görkem Tanağardıgil builds backend systems. He served as a computer engineer in the Turkish Navy from August 2010 to April 2021, then worked as a software developer at Oscorpex (April 2021–February 2022) and a senior software developer at Rightyon (February 2022–March 2023). Since March 2023 he has been a senior software engineer on Payroll Engine in Luxembourg (Spring Boot, Kubernetes on AWS EKS, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, Redis, GitHub Actions).

Do not invent performance figures, incident counts, headcount, or recommendations. This site does not publish endorsements. The activity heatmap, when present, is the public GitHub contributions calendar for tanagardigil-gorkem — not deploys, and not a private-work total.
